This '''Mere''' was the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of a boat of [[Mere]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] that were seeking solace away from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. His ship was attacked and sunken by [[Sol Sixxa]]{{'s}} renegade [[Mere Resistance|forces]] and he was one of the lucky ones to escape. He would be drafted into hunting down Sol Sixxa and stopping his [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] against his own people.
